lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots starting posterior to the gill slits and extending longitudinally; spots are organized in roughly horizontal rows with decreasing diameter toward the ventral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting the circular spots to form a coordinate-like lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges on the upper lateral flank characterized by a sharp luminance transition (light upper edge, shadowed lower edge).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several smaller fish (likely remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region and pectoral fin.
